sentences.text: The present petition has been filed under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail to the petitioner in case FIR No.18 dated 01.10.2022 under Sections 406, 420 and 120 B of the IPC registered at Police Station NRI, Police Commissionerate Ludhiana.
Learned counsel for the petitioner inter alia contends that the it was essentially a civil dispute pertaining to agreement to sell which had been given a criminal complexion.
He further submits that in compliance of order dated 28.10.2022, the petitioner has joined investigation and cooperated with the investigating agency.
Learned State counsel on instructions does not dispute the factum of the petitioner having joined investigation and cooperated with the investigating agency.

He on further instructions submits that Varinder Singh vs State Of Punjab on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/53694065/
1 the petitioner is not required for further investigation much less for his 1 of 2 Neutral Citation No:=2023:PHHC:032420 custodial interrogation.

sentences.text:
In view of the above, the petition is allowed and interim order dated 28.10.2022, is made absolute subject to the conditions laid down in Section 438(2) Cr.P.C.
